programs.title: Point Guard Shooting Series #1
programs.summary: Five days of game-speed shooting volume. Form work Day 1, off-dribble and game-speed reps as the week progresses.

drills.name: Form shots from 6 feet
drills.description: Stand 6 ft from rim. Shot pocket low, elbow under the ball, follow-through with full extension and hold. Hand under, not on the side.

drills.name: Catch-and-shoot from 5 spots
drills.description: Spin pass to yourself, catch in shot pocket, square hips and shoulders to rim, shoot in rhythm. Don't dip the ball. Spots: left corner, left wing, top, right wing, right corner.

drills.name: One-dribble pull-ups from each elbow
drills.description: Start at the top of the key. One hard dribble to the elbow, gather, pull up. Footwork: inside foot plants first. Right side first, then left.

drills.name: Wing drive + pull-up
drills.description: From the wing, hard dribble to the elbow, jab-style pull-up. Focus on shoulder square and balance. Right then left.

drills.name: Hesitation into pull-up at the elbow
drills.description: Slow-fast move — change pace mid-dribble, then pull. The hesitation sells it. Don't shortcut the gather.

drills.name: Step-back from the wing
drills.description: Drive baseline 2 steps, push off front foot, step back into shot pocket. Stay low through the move.

drills.name: 3-point catch-and-shoot from 5 spots
drills.description: Same 5 spots as Day 1 but behind the line. Spin pass, catch ready, shoot. Strong base, no fade.

drills.name: Off-the-dribble 3 from wing
drills.description: One hard side-step dribble before the pull. Stay behind the line. Get used to the rhythm of one-dribble 3s.

drills.name: Spot-up shooting under closeout pressure
drills.description: Partner or chair closeout. Catch, rip-through, shoot or one-dribble pull depending on the closeout. Game decision.

drills.name: Pull-up off pick simulation
drills.description: Set imaginary screen at the top. Dribble off it, attack downhill, pull at the elbow. Get the angle right.

drills.name: Free throws at the end (fatigued)
drills.description: After all your shooting work, shoot FTs. Routine the same every time. Breathe. Bend knees same depth.

drills.name: 5-spot make-it streak
drills.description: From each spot, make 5 in a row before moving. If you miss, start that spot over. Corner → wing → top → wing → corner. Mental rep as much as physical.
drills.reps_or_time: Make 5 in a row from each of 5 spots

drills.name: Free throws
drills.description: Routine every time. Same dribbles, same breath, same release. Track the streak.

drills.name: End-of-game shot simulation
drills.description: 5 seconds on imaginary clock. Count down out loud (3-2-1), catch-and-shoot a 3. Reset, repeat. Mental rep matters more than form here.

programs.title: Point Guard Ball Handling Series #1
programs.summary: Three short days for HS point guards — tight handles, weak hand confidence, and change-of-pace moves.

drills.name: Pound dribble progression
drills.description: Pound the ball hard at hip height. Knees bent, eyes up, never look down at the ball. Right hand 30 sec, then left, then alternate every dribble for 30 sec. Rest 30 sec between rounds.

drills.name: Stationary handle sequence
drills.description: One set = crossover (8 reps), between the legs (8 reps), behind the back (8 reps), in-and-out (8 reps). Keep the dribble low and hard. Don't get sloppy when you're tired.

drills.name: Weak hand pound — height changes
drills.description: Left hand only. Pound dribble and change heights every 15 sec — high, low, high, low. Eyes up the whole time. This is the drill that closes the gap between your hands.

drills.name: Full-court speed dribble
drills.description: Push dribble at top speed end-to-end. Stay low, push the ball out in front of you (not next to you). Trip 1 right, trip 2 left, repeat. Touch each baseline.

drills.name: Hesitation move attack
drills.description: Start at half-court. Dribble at controlled pace, hesitate — slow down, sit, drop your shoulders like you're about to settle — then explode past an imaginary defender. Right side first, then left.

drills.name: Crossover at speed
drills.description: Half-court to baseline at game speed. Each trip pick ONE move at the elbow area: crossover, between the legs, behind the back. Keep your eyes up the entire trip.
drills.reps_or_time: 8 trips down, one move per trip

drills.name: Two-ball synchronized pound
drills.description: Hold one ball in each hand. Pound dribble both at the same time at hip height. Both bounces hit the floor together. Builds even hand strength and rhythm.

drills.name: Two-ball alternating
drills.description: One ball goes up while the other goes down. Alternating dribbles. Will feel awkward at first — that's the point. Eyes up forces you to feel the rhythm instead of looking.

drills.name: 1-on-0 attack from top
drills.description: Start at top of key. Pick ONE move (crossover, between legs, behind back, or hesi) and attack the rim at full speed. Finish strong at the rim. This is the game rep — make every one count.
